subject.title: feat(hooks): emit session prune lifecycle event

question: What permanent contract should `session:prune` expose before this maintainer-protected PR can land?
rationale: The implementation direction affects plugin-visible hook semantics, session/tool metadata exposure, and whether pruning can block on installed handlers; automation should not choose that boundary.

options.title: Port bounded metadata hook
options.body: Port to the active agent-hooks path with typed session identity, sanitized/capped metadata, timeout or fire-and-forget delivery, and docs/tests for the payload contract.

options.title: Sponsor broader lifecycle design
options.body: Keep this PR paused while maintainers design a broader reset/prune/session-memory lifecycle that covers related issues too.

options.title: Close in favor of replacement
options.body: Close this branch and keep the linked issue open for a narrower replacement PR against current main.

recommendation.title: Port bounded metadata hook
recommendation.body: Port to the active agent-hooks path with typed session identity, sanitized/capped metadata, timeout or fire-and-forget delivery, and docs/tests for the payload contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored this implementation candidate and have current-main hook/docs history, making them the closest owner for the proposed hook contract.
